suggestions: I'm grateful for a pull request that got approved on the first review, no nitpicks, no back and forth.
I'm thankful for the azan drifting in through the window right as I close the laptop for the night.
I'm grateful for nasi lemak that still had the sambal hot enough to wake me up properly.
I'm thankful for a colleague who covered my on-call shift without making it a whole negotiation.
I'm grateful for the bus actually arriving on schedule for once, no fifteen minute guessing game.
I'm thankful for my mum's voice note reminding me to drink water, as if I'm still twelve.
I'm grateful for a flaky test that finally stopped being flaky after I actually read the error.
I'm thankful for the stillness right before subuh, before the group chats start blowing up.
I'm grateful for a kopitiam uncle who remembered my order without me saying a word.
I'm thankful for a production rollback that worked cleanly on the first try, no panic required.
I'm grateful for the salary notification clearing a day before rent is due, rezeki with good timing.
I'm thankful for an old Stack Overflow answer that solved a problem nobody else seemed to have.
I'm grateful for my grandmother asking if I've been praying, nagging dressed up as love.
I'm thankful for the one traffic light that stayed green the whole way home from a long sprint review.
I'm grateful for a teammate explaining a legacy system to me without making me feel stupid for asking.
